newsitem.title: UK: Boots shares to head for 700p.
newsitem.headline: Boots shares to head for 700p.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-25 * MA-200
+ Chart patterns for Boots' suggest the stock could go up to 700p over the medium-to-long term, technical analysts said.

+ This follows a chart breakout from 650p in January and a golden-cross pattern between the stock's 25 and 200 day moving averages. But no confirmation has been given by a long-term chart of the stock's relative strength against the All-Share index -- implying the shares' progress may not be so fast.

Boots' share price spiked up in the second half of 1996 peaking at 643p in October from a low of 555p in July. It then fell back, retracing around 60 percent of that rise before embarking on its present upward path.
This has enabled Boots' 25 day moving average to cross above the 200 day average -- making a bullish golden cross pattern -- which implies long-term underlying strength in the share price.

"The 200 day moving average is rising gently but the relative strength ratio (of the share price divided by the All-Share index) has not broken its long-term downtrend extending back over four years," said Marshall.
This would imply reasonably steady progress for the shares rather than something dynamic, added Marshall.
